title: Detention and Recipe
author: Dominic Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Marchetti, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
